SELECT ROUND(AVG(temperature), 2) AS temperature, MIN(env_id) AS envId, DATE_FORMAT(join_date, #{groupFormat}) AS joinDate FROM environment WHERE join_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{intervalValue} HOUR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(join_date, #{groupFormat}) ORDER BY joinDate ASC
